ai-specs_ai-specs.toml.content:
# ai-specs.toml — root manifest for the ai-specs standard.
#
# Single source of truth for: enabled agents, vendored skills (deps),
# MCP servers, and recipes. Local skills live under ai-specs/skills/<name>/
# and are autodiscovered — they are not listed here.

[project]
name = "ai-specs-cli"
subrepos = []

[agents]
# Supported agents: claude, cursor, opencode, codex, copilot, gemini, pi, omp
enabled = ["claude", "cursor", "opencode", "pi", "omp"]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Recipes — named bundles of skills, commands, templates, and MCP presets.
# Declared in catalog/recipes/<id>/recipe.toml. Sync uses the installed CLI
# catalog; no per-recipe version pin is required.
#
# [recipes.<id>]
# enabled = true
# # version = "1.0.0"  # legacy — ignored with WARN if present

# Flow primitives for this project come from these catalog recipes. Local
# skills under ai-specs/skills/ are limited to ai-specs' own bundled tooling
# (skill-creator, skill-sync); everything else of the flow is provided here
# plus the gentle-ai stack (SDD, memory).
#
# Recipes follow the capability model (see docs/capabilities.md):
#   foundational (consume capabilities): worktree-flow, git-pr-flow,
#     session-context, tdd-flow, plan-build-flow
#   specific (provide a capability): trello-mcp-workflow (tracker),
#     vault-canonical-store (canonical-store)
# Each capability has exactly one provider here, so sync auto-binds them; no
# explicit [[bindings]] are needed until a second provider is added (e.g. a
# jira recipe alongside trello — then bind `tracker` to one of them).

# --- Foundational ---

[recipes.worktree-flow]
enabled = true
[recipes.worktree-flow.config]
worktrees_dir = ".worktrees"
integration_branch = "epic/go-single-binary"
gate_mode="ask"
[recipes.git-pr-flow]
enabled = true
[recipes.git-pr-flow.config]
# Scoped to this branch: every card of the Go single-binary migration targets the
# epic integration branch, never development. The value travels with the branch,
# so a hotfix cut from development still resolves base_branch = "development".
base_branch = "epic/go-single-binary"
expected_owner = "parada1104"
auto_switch_account = true

[recipes.session-context]
enabled = true

[recipes.tdd-flow]
enabled = true
[recipes.tdd-flow.config]
test_command = "./tests/validate.sh"

[recipes.trello-mcp-workflow]
enabled = true
[recipes.trello-mcp-workflow.config]
board_id = "69ec097f13e2d38ecd89a557"
gate_mode = "warn"

default_list = "In Progress"
done_list = "Done"
reconcile = { scope_field = "board_id", max_age_seconds = 900, expectations = [{ event = "delivery", property = "list", config_field = "default_list" }, { event = "review", property = "list", config_field = "review_list" }, { event = "merge", property = "list", config_field = "done_list", config_field_when_set = "published_list" }] }
review_list = "Review"
[recipes.vault-canonical-store]
enabled = true
[recipes.vault-canonical-store.config]
vault_scope = "nnodes/proyectos/ai-specs"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vendored skill dependencies — each [[deps]] entry is cloned by
# `ai-specs sync` into ai-specs/skills/<id>/ (gitignored).
#
# id                  (req) target directory under skills/
# source              (req) git URL (anything `git clone` accepts)
# path                (opt) subdirectory inside the repo where SKILL.md lives
# scope               (opt) default ["root"]
# auto_invoke         (opt) trigger phrases for the AGENTS.md Auto-invoke table
# license             (opt) SPDX identifier
# vendor_attribution  (opt) upstream author/org, cited in the skill description
# version             (opt) semantic version for metadata.version
#
# [[deps]]
# id = "tdd"
# source = "https://github.com/obra/superpowers"
# path = "skills/test-driven-development"
# license = "MIT"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Explicit capability bindings — only needed when multiple enabled recipes
# declare the same capability (to resolve ambiguity). With a single provider
# per capability, sync auto-binds them; no explicit [[bindings]] are needed.
#
# Example (uncomment to override auto-bind):
# [[bindings]]
# capability = "tracker"
# recipe = "trello-mcp-workflow"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MCP servers — distributed by sync-agent to each platform's native format.
# Environment variables are loaded from .envrc; agents interpolate at runtime
# (e.g. $TRELLO_API_KEY).
#
# All current servers come from recipe presets ([[provides.mcp]]):
#   trello          ← trello-mcp-workflow
#   vault-canonical ← vault-canonical-store (path via $CANONICAL_VAULT_PATH in .envrc)
# Declare [mcp.<name>] here only for ad-hoc servers without a recipe preset:
#
# [mcp.example]
# command = "npx"
# args = ["-y", "@example/mcp-server"]
# env = { EXAMPLE_TOKEN = "$EXAMPLE_TOKEN" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Runtime brief — prose sections for AGENTS.md generation.
# Structured values (board_id, integration_branch, test_command, vault_scope)
# come from recipe configs above. Only prose with no structured home lives here.

[brief]
intro = """
This is the project's director de orquesta: canonical runtime context for agents.
It covers project identity, MCPs, context sources, safety rules, and workflow conventions.
It does NOT track day-to-day work state — that lives in Trello and Engram.

**YOU ARE ON THE GO SINGLE-BINARY MIGRATION BRANCH, NOT development.**
This branch and every branch cut from it operate under the epic contract below.
Rules you may know from `development` do not all apply here: the integration
target is `epic/go-single-binary`, and nothing from this epic reaches
`development` until the whole migration is verified. Epic:
https://trello.com/c/qwlHQ7Xa
"""
purpose = "per-project AI harness for agent configuration, MCPs, recipes, memory, and tracker integration."
runtime_flow = [
  "A session works on one explicit user request or Trello card.",
  "The orchestrator coordinates work inline using project skills and the runtime brief.",
  "`explore` can run without a worktree when it only produces thinking.",
]
# The worktree requirement for protected-branch writes is contributed by the
# worktree-flow recipe (config-aware via `gate_mode`), not hard-coded here.
# "Trello is the source of truth..." is now contributed by trello-mcp-workflow recipe
# (key: trello-source-of-truth). Project-specific entries remain here.
context_sources = [
  "Specs and changes are tracked in the project's designated spec store (configurable per project).",
  "Vault is the canonical note-taker for decisions, handoffs, and structured project context.",
  "Engram is the operational memory layer for session facts, patterns, and short-lived continuity.",
  "Skills are executable guidance, not the primary contents of this runtime brief. Load specific skills by id when relevant (local under `ai-specs/skills/`, or CLI-bundled / recipe / dep via agent fan-out).",
  "Check Engram for the current active card and next recommended focus.",
]
# "Current explicit human instruction controls..." and "Tracker controls work state..."
# are now contributed by session-context recipe (keys: conflict-policy-source-authority,
# conflict-policy-source-hierarchy). Project-specific entries naming Trello/Vault remain.
conflict_policy = [
  "Skills define reusable procedures. Engram provides searchable operational context, not final authority.",
  "Proposed agent plans are lowest authority until accepted and recorded in Trello, Vault, docs, or code.",
]
# Most workflow rules are now contributed by worktree-flow, git-pr-flow, tdd-flow, and
# session-context recipes. Only project-specific rules remain here.
# worktree-flow already contributes: "Do not merge or push to `development` without a PR
# and explicit human instruction." — the version below adds the explicit-human-instruction
# emphasis for operations that bypass the PR (e.g. direct hotfix on dev).
workflow_rules = [
  "Follow the project's designated workflow for structured changes.",
  "Direct `skill-sync` runs are allowed only for metadata validation.",
  # Project-level Python→Go strangler policy (card #126). Incremental: apply at the seam you touch.
  "New authoritative logic, state machines, predicates, and durable state belong in Go.",
  "When touching Python on the active path, migrate the behavior/dependency being touched to Go where practical; Python may remain only as a thin compatibility/acquisition/JSON bridge during the transition.",
  "Keep one authoritative grader per behavior and add parity/contract tests at each migrated seam.",
  "Do not perform unrelated drive-by rewrites; the policy is incremental.",
  "EPIC CONTRACT — Go single-binary migration (https://trello.com/c/qwlHQ7Xa). This branch is the integration target for that epic. Card branches are cut FROM `epic/go-single-binary` and their PRs target it. No PR from this epic ever targets `development` or `main`.",
  "EPIC CONTRACT — Nothing from this epic reaches `development` while the epic is open. After all 16 cards are verified, ONE promotion PR is opened from card 16 (Cutover). Unrelated feature work continues on `development` in parallel and must not be disturbed.",
  "EPIC CONTRACT — TWO config values are deliberately scoped to this branch: `[recipes.git-pr-flow.config].base_branch` and `[recipes.worktree-flow.config].integration_branch`. BOTH MUST be reverted to `development` before the promotion PR, or every PR and worktree flow in the project starts targeting a deleted branch. Tracked as a blocking step on card 16.",
  "EPIC CONTRACT — New development moves toward the migration: no new Python modules under `lib/_internal/`, no new Bash logic in `lib/`, no new vendored Python under `lib/_vendor/`. New behavior in an already-ported area is written in Go; in a not-yet-ported area it must not deepen the Bash/Python surface.",
  "EPIC CONTRACT — Ported behavior is verified against `docs/go-migration-parity-contract.md`, which classifies every CLI surface FROZEN / TOLERANT / FREE. Do not 'fix' behavior recorded there as FROZEN, even when it looks wrong; recorded defects (D1-D35) are separate cards.",
  "DELEGATION — Orca workers own change content inside their assigned worktree only. A worker never stages, commits, pushes, merges, or manages worktree lifecycle; the canonical orchestrator owns those. See the `orca-aware-delegation` skill.",
  "DELEGATION — Never launch a worker headless (`pi -p`, `claude -p`, `opencode run`, provider API calls). Orca workers launch as visible interactive TUI sessions via `worker-start`.",
  "DELEGATION — `worker_done` never implies terminal closure by itself. Standing human decision for this epic: release once a worker completes its change cycle, since the PR lifecycle belongs to the orchestrator. Release only after an accepted `worker_done` — never on a timeout, idle TUI, heartbeat, question, escalation, or stale report — and retain anything that escalated, asked, or failed pending inspection.",
]# useful_commands_mode = "replace" keeps only the auto-generated test_command line and
# project-specific manual commands; suppresses recipe fragments that would duplicate
# the auto-generated "Full validation: ./tests/validate.sh" line.
useful_commands_mode = "replace"
useful_commands = [
  "Focused tests (unit-only): `./tests/run.sh`",
  "Inspect the active Trello card before resuming work.",
]

[brief.mcp_descriptions]
trello = "project tracking through the ai-specs-cli Roadmap board."
engram = "operational/session memory (global MCP)."
"vault-canonical" = "canonical project notes in the vault scoped to `nnodes/proyectos/ai-specs` (path from $CANONICAL_VAULT_PATH)."

# read_text translates CRLF to LF in memory, so the round-trip output is
# LF-normalized on both sides — including inside multi-line strings.

multi
line
"""

[recipes.b]

# The valid→invalid guard refuses, so the ORIGINAL CRLF bytes must stay

["x"],
]

y = 1

catalog_recipes_trello-mcp-workflow_reci.content:
[recipe]
id = "trello-mcp-workflow"
name = "Trello MCP Workflow"
description = "Automated Trello board integration for ai-specs SDD workflows"
version = "1.4.0"
tags = ["tracker", "trello"]

[[capabilities]]
id = "tracker"

[[capabilities]]
id = "trello-session-bootstrap"

[[capabilities]]
id = "trello-card-linking"

[[capabilities]]
id = "trello-state-sync"

[[capabilities]]
id = "trello-progress-comment"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "validate-config"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "bootstrap-board"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "link-trello-card"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "sync-card-state"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "comment-verification"

[[deps.cli]]
binary = "npx"
purpose = "Run the Trello MCP server (@delorenj/mcp-server-trello)"
required = true
install_url = "https://nodejs.org/en/download"
version_check = "npx --version"
min_version = "8.0.0"

[config.board_id]
required = true
type = "string"
validation.regex = '^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$'
help_text = "Trello board ID: 24 hex chars (e.g. 69ec097f13e2d38ecd89a557). Not the 8-char shortLink in https://trello.com/b/<shortLink>/.... Tip: trello_get_active_board_info → id, or Board menu → More → Close board URL."

[config.default_list]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "In Progress"
help_text = "Default list where new cards land. Must match an existing list name on your Trello board."

[config.epic_list]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "Epic"
help_text = "List name for epic-type cards. Must match an existing list on your Trello board (create the list first if needed)."

[config.review_list]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "Review"
help_text = "List a card must reach when the review lifecycle event reconciles. Must match an existing list on your Trello board."

[config.done_list]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "Done"
help_text = "List a card must reach when the merge lifecycle event reconciles. Must match an existing list on your Trello board."

[config.published_list]
required = false
type = "string"
help_text = "Optional list that means the merge was also published/released (e.g. Published). Leave it unset when the board has no such list: the merge event then reconciles against done_list. No default is invented, and an unset value is never treated as configured."

[config.board_isolation]
forbidden_tools = ["trello_get_my_cards", "trello_list_boards"]
restricted_tools = ["trello_set_active_board"]
card_validation_required = true


[config.gate_mode]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "warn"
enum = ["off", "warn", "always"]
help_text = "Deprecated compatibility only: the Trello tracker is advisory and never blocks source changes. Legacy off (skip the Tracker checkpoints), warn (report only), or always (strictest verdict). Consulted only when ledger_mode is unset; prefer ledger_mode."

[config.ledger_mode]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "warn"
enum = ["always", "ask", "warn"]
help_text = "Canonical Tracker ledger mode: always (strictest verdict; the Plan Build work-start checkpoint may still block on it), ask (prompt at each checkpoint; an opt-out is lifecycle-scoped), or warn (report on stderr — default). Tracker checkpoints never block source changes: a block/ask/needs-item is reported and the host continues. Overrides gate_mode when set; gate_mode off still skips the Tracker checkpoints."

# Remote reconciliation mapping (ledger remote reconciliation, T2). This is the
# recipe's Tracker-domain adapter declaration: it maps native config values to
# neutral properties and never grades or sets ledger policy (ledger_mode/gate_mode
# stay in their own separate config). It declares which config fields a comparison
# may read: the scope the observation must report, and, per event, the property it
# declares plus the config field whose value that property must show. It is provider
# adaptation, never provider state: nothing here is compared against a stored item
# status.
#
# The Go gate reads the runtime values from the project manifest
# (`[recipes.trello-mcp-workflow.config]` and this same table in
# ai-specs/ai-specs.toml), so a project that does not bind the block gets an
# explicit non-agreeing `unconfigured` result. This block is the recipe-side
# declaration and wizard/doctor documentation — never a runtime fallback — and Go
# hardcodes no field name, property name, list name, or freshness window. The
# recipe schema validates this block's shape (`scope_field`, `max_age_seconds`,
# `expectations` entries) and sync carries the project-declared block through
# without the old unknown-key warning.
#
# `merge` is conditional and recipe-owned: it targets `published_list` only when
# the project configured that list, and `done_list` otherwise. The condition is
# declarative (`config_field_when_set`) so the project still configures list names
# only; it never hand-authors which property maps to which list.
[config.reconcile]
scope_field = "board_id"
max_age_seconds = 900

[[config.reconcile.expectations]]
event = "delivery"
property = "list"
config_field = "default_list"

[[config.reconcile.expectations]]
event = "review"
property = "list"
config_field = "review_list"

[[config.reconcile.expectations]]
event = "merge"
property = "list"
config_field = "done_list"
config_field_when_set = "published_list"

[init]
prompt = "init.md"
description = "Configure Trello board and list mappings before sync"
needs_manifest = true
needs_mcp = ["trello"]

[provides]
skills = [{ id = "trello-mcp-workflow", source = "bundled" }]
commands = [{ id = "trello-workflow", path = "commands/trello-workflow.md" }]

[provides.brief]
workflow_rules = [
    "Inspect the active Trello card before resuming work and keep card state in sync with actual progress.",
    "Before apply/production work on a structured change, create or link a Trello card and record it in the ## Tracker section of the change's proposal.md (or tasks.md) — card_id + url. openspec/** writes are never gated — write the link section there first.",
    "On SDD phase transitions, move the card and update its phase label; post a progress comment at milestones.",
    "The tracker gate is advisory: a warn/block/ask verdict is a prompt to create/link the card and write the ## Tracker section — never bypass via shell writes, and never claim 'Trello unavailable' when the real gap is a missing link section. A missing card is an availability failure only when the MCP/network is genuinely down.",
    "Only omit a card by writing openspec/changes/<slug>/tracker.none with a one-line reason; this is logged and rare.",
    "Tracker lifecycle checkpoints are Plan Build-independent: grade them with the tracker gate's direct host mode `ai-specs/recipes/trello-mcp-workflow/hooks/tracker-card-gate.sh --root <root> --checkpoint pre-merge|archive-close [slug]`; no openspec/ tree is required, and `archive-close` is tracker item closure, never an OpenSpec archive.",
    "Provider tracker recipes only map native state through `[config.reconcile]`; they never enable, configure, or implement the ledger, and they never grade items.",
]

[[provides.brief.context_sources]]
key = "trello-source-of-truth"
text = "Trello is the source of truth for work state and dependencies."

[[provides.brief.mcp_descriptions]]
key = "trello"
text = "Project tracking via the configured Trello board."

[[provides.mcp]]
id = "trello"
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@delorenj/mcp-server-trello"]
env = { TRELLO_API_KEY = "$TRELLO_API_KEY", TRELLO_TOKEN = "$TRELLO_TOKEN" }
timeout = 30000


[[provides.hooks]]
id = "tracker-card-gate"
event = "pre-tool-use"
script = "hooks/tracker-card-gate.sh"
matcher = "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"
blocking = false
description = "Advisory: report a production edit's apply-start ledger verdict through the verified Go predicate; a block/ask/needs-item is reported and never blocks source work; fail open"

[[provides.hooks]]
id = "tracker-card-gate-shell"
event = "pre-tool-use"
script = "hooks/tracker-card-gate.sh"
matcher = "Bash|Shell|Execute|Terminal"
blocking = false
description = "Advisory: report a `gh pr create` pr-review ledger verdict through the verified Go predicate; never blocks; does not gate shell writes"

[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/card-feature.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/trello-mcp-workflow/overrides/templates/card-feature.md"
condition = "not_exists"

[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/card-bug.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/trello-mcp-workflow/overrides/templates/card-bug.md"
condition = "not_exists"

[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/card-spike.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/trello-mcp-workflow/overrides/templates/card-spike.md"
condition = "not_exists"

[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/card-epic.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/trello-mcp-workflow/overrides/templates/card-epic.md"
condition = "not_exists"

[[provides.templates]]

catalog_recipes_worktree-flow_recipe.tom.content:
[recipe]
id = "worktree-flow"
name = "Worktree Flow"
description = "Isolated git worktrees under .worktrees/ with post-merge cleanup for ai-specs change work"
version = "1.6.0"
author = "ai-specs"
license = "MIT"
tags = ["infra", "worktree"]

[[capabilities]]
id = "worktree-isolation"

[[capabilities]]
id = "worktree-cleanup"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "validate-config"

[[deps.cli]]
binary = "git"
purpose = "Create and manage git worktrees under .worktrees/"
required = true
install_url = "https://git-scm.com/downloads"
version_check = "git --version"
min_version = "2.20.0"

[config.worktrees_dir]
required = false
type = "string"
default = ".worktrees"
help_text = "Directory for isolated git worktrees (relative to project root). Usually .worktrees/ and gitignored."

[config.integration_branch]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "main"
help_text = "Branch worktrees are created from and merged into (e.g. main or development). Must already exist in the repo."

[config.auto_remove_merged]
required = false
type = "bool"
default = true
help_text = "If true, worktree cleanup removes worktrees whose branches are fully merged into the integration branch."

# Protected branches the worktree-gate runtime hook refuses writes on while in
# the main worktree. Passed to the rendered hook as the WORKTREE_GATE_PROTECTED
# env var (space-separated branch names).
[config.WORKTREE_GATE_PROTECTED]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "main development"
help_text = "Space-separated branch names the worktree gate protects in the main worktree (writes blocked unless gate_mode allows)."

[config.gate_mode]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "always"
enum = ["always", "ask", "off"]
help_text = "Worktree gate behavior: always (block + worktree guidance), ask (block and ask the user for a destination: worktree / feature branch / explicit protected-branch override), or off (disabled)."

[config.gate_scope]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "auto"
enum = ["auto", "superrepo", "subrepo"]
help_text = "Repository scope for worktree-gate: auto (proven topology), superrepo (canonical central planning only), or subrepo (initialized submodule protection); independent from gate_mode and repo_topology."

[config.gate_impl]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "auto"
enum = ["auto", "go"]
help_text = "Worktree gate implementation: auto (use the Go binary when the CLI can provide it) or go (explicit Go pin). Both acquire the verified binary and fail open with a doctor ERROR when none resolves. The bash value has been removed."


# Legacy compatibility alias only. Topology is owned by the project manifest
# ([project].repo_topology); this key is still read (with a deprecation marker)
# for one migration window and is never written by new flows.
[config.repo_topology]
type = "string"
required = false
default = "auto"
enum = ["auto", "standalone", "monorepo-apps", "monorepo-submodules"]
help_text = "Deprecated alias of [project].repo_topology (still honored for one migration window; recipe-only values warn). Prefer the project field: auto (detect initialized submodules → monorepo-submodules, else standalone), standalone, monorepo-apps (naming-only; same mechanics as standalone), or monorepo-submodules (per-submodule worktrees under shared worktrees_dir)."


[provides]
skills = [{ id = "worktree-flow", source = "bundled" }]
commands = [
    { id = "worktree-new", path = "commands/worktree-new.md" },
    { id = "worktree-clean", path = "commands/worktree-clean.md" },
]

[provides.brief]
workflow_rules = [
    "Protected-branch writes are governed by the effective worktree `gate_mode = {config.gate_mode}`: `always` requires a dedicated worktree before writing; `ask` requires the orchestrator to ask the user to choose a destination (a dedicated worktree, a feature branch in the current checkout, or an explicit protected-branch override); `off` permits writing where the user directs. Pure exploration can proceed without a worktree when it writes no files.",
    "Do not merge or push to `{config.integration_branch}` without a PR and explicit human instruction.",
    "Preserve unrelated worktree changes; never revert changes you did not make.",
    "Before dispatching a write-capable subagent or task, verify which git repository, worktree, and branch yourself (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `git branch --show-current`, `git worktree list`). Under monorepo-submodules, confirming which-repo via show-toplevel is mandatory. Do not rely solely on runtime pre-tool-use hooks — they may not fire for delegated/subprocess tool calls on opencode/pi/omp.",
    "If a structured Edit/Write/MultiEdit call is blocked or errors for any reason while on a protected branch, that is never grounds to retry the write via bash/shell (heredoc, `python3 -c`, `cat >`, `tee`, `sed -i`). With `gate_mode = always`, create a dedicated worktree first (e.g. `/worktree-new`) and write there instead; with `gate_mode = ask`, ask the user which destination to use — worktree (recommended), feature branch in place, or explicit protected-branch override — and wait; with `gate_mode = off`, the gate does not block.",
]

[[provides.hooks]]
id = "worktree-gate"
event = "pre-tool-use"
script = "hooks/worktree-gate.sh"
matcher = "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"
blocking = true
description = "Block writes to the main worktree on a protected branch"

[[provides.hooks]]
id = "worktree-gate-shell"
event = "pre-tool-use"
script = "hooks/worktree-gate.sh"
matcher = "Bash|Shell|Execute|Terminal"
blocking = true
description = "Best-effort block shell commands that write into the main worktree on a protected branch (bash-bypass coverage)"
[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/worktree-cleanup.sh"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/worktree-flow/overrides/bin/worktree-cleanup.sh"
condition = "not_exists"

# Managed VCS post-merge close trigger. Sync stamps the project's configured
# worktrees_dir, integration_branch, and repo_topology into the wrapper, which
# passes them to the materialized cleanup launcher; cleanup closes the matching
# ledger item at archive-close before it removes a merged worktree or local
# branch. The not_exists condition preserves any existing user hook at this path.
[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/post-merge.sh"
target = ".git/hooks/post-merge"
condition = "not_exists"

[[provides.docs]]
source = "README.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/worktree-flow/README.md"

catalog_recipes_plan-build-flow_recipe.t.content:
[recipe]
id = "plan-build-flow"
name = "Plan / Build Flow"
description = "Ambient change workflow: depth classifier, silent planning artifacts, PR/archive gates"
version = "1.8.0"
author = "ai-specs"
license = "MIT"
tags = ["workflow"]

[[capabilities]]
id = "plan-build-flow"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "validate-config"

[config.artifact_store_default]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "openspec"
enum = ["openspec", "engram", "both"]
help_text = "External-session persistence preference for this project's planning artifacts: openspec, engram, or both. Plan-build readiness is always proven by file-backed artifacts in the canonical change-folder tree."

[provides]
skills = [{ id = "plan-build-flow", source = "bundled" }]

[provides.brief]
workflow_rules = [
    "Classify each substantial change (full planning chain, spec+tasks, or tasks-only) before writing production code; compute the signal depth, compare any explicit requested depth, ask on conflicts, and annotate requested/signal/decided depth in tasks.md before authorization.",
    "Direct implementation requests without a change folder still require planning at the classified depth; approval verbs do not skip the plan step.",
    "Do not open a PR until the change folder on the branch contains the tier minimum planning files (Light: proposal.md + tasks.md; Standard: proposal.md + tasks.md + specs/**/*.md; Full: tasks.md plus proposal.md or design.md plus specs/**/*.md), committed.",
    "After authorization, implement and validate in the change worktree when isolated worktrees are enabled.",
    "Before merge on the review branch: run verify evidence (Standard/Full block without a conforming verify-report.md; Light is advisory), then promote canonical specs so every delta under specs/<domain>/spec.md is composed into openspec/specs/<domain>/spec.md (the promoter is the only writer and the guardian only validates), then pass the pre-archive guardian, then archive the change folder at openspec/changes/archive/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/ using a valid ISO calendar date, then run the pre-merge guardian again; an unpromoted or unresolved delta blocks Standard/Full, exact undated archive/<slug>/ is legacy fallback only, ambiguity and malformed or near-match candidates block, and archive is never deferred until after merge.",
    "Default artifact store for this project's planning artifacts: `{config.artifact_store_default}`. When a session asks where planning artifacts should live, answer with this value unless the user overrides it. The store is a persistence preference only: plan-build readiness is always proven by the file-backed canonical change-folder tree, never by a memory-only store.",
    "For recognized submodule worktrees, use the topology-derived central planning tree in the superproject; standalone repositories keep their own planning tree.",
    "Full planning runs logical phases explore -> proposal -> spec/design -> tasks; use a host-advertised executor for the current phase when available, otherwise run that phase inline; never skip phases.",
    "Phase executor results that are malformed, partial, or blocked stop and preserve planning state; unavailable executors may use inline fallback. Standard and Light behavior remains collapsed and unchanged.",
    "Consume one session-level preflight for execution mode, artifact store, review budget, delivery strategy, and chain strategy; never recollect or override those values.",
    "Present an artifact-derived plan with intent, scope, key decisions, affected areas, risks, open questions, and labeled recommendations/assumptions; ask accept, adjust, or stop and block unresolved product decisions."
]

[[provides.hooks]]
id = "plan-build-gate"
event = "pre-tool-use"
script = "hooks/plan-build-gate.sh"
matcher = "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"
blocking = true
description = "Block production edits until an active change folder with a tasks.md plan exists"

[[provides.docs]]
source = "README.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/plan-build-flow/README.md"

[recipe]
id = "vault-canonical-store"
name = "Vault Canonical Store"

version = "1.2.0"
author = "ai-specs"
license = "MIT"

[[capabilities]]
id = "canonical-store"

[[hooks]]

action = "validate-config"

[[deps.cli]]
binary = "npx"
purpose = "Run the filesystem MCP server for the canonical vault store"
required = true
install_url = "https://nodejs.org/en/download"
version_check = "npx --version"
min_version = "8.0.0"

[config.vault_scope]
required = false
type = "string"
help_text = "Relative path under the vault root for this project (e.g. nnodes/proyectos/ai-specs). Combined with CANONICAL_VAULT_PATH / Obsidian vault."

[config.decisions_folder]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "decisiones"
help_text = "Folder name under vault_scope for durable decision notes."

[config.sessions_folder]
required = false
type = "string"
default = "sessions"
help_text = "Folder name under vault_scope for session handoffs / summaries."

[provides]
skills = [
  { id = "vault-context", source = "bundled" },
  # kepano/obsidian-skills — Obsidian-native stack for LLM wiki / second-brain notes
  { id = "obsidian-markdown", source = "dep", url = "https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills.git", path = "skills/obsidian-markdown" },
  { id = "obsidian-bases", source = "dep", url = "https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills.git", path = "skills/obsidian-bases" },
  { id = "json-canvas", source = "dep", url = "https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills.git", path = "skills/json-canvas" },
  { id = "obsidian-cli", source = "dep", url = "https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills.git", path = "skills/obsidian-cli" },
  { id = "defuddle", source = "dep", url = "https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills.git", path = "skills/defuddle" },
]

[[provides.brief.context_sources]]
key = "vault-canonical-note-taker"
text = "Vault is the canonical note-taker for decisions, handoffs, and structured project context."

[[provides.brief.mcp_descriptions]]
key = "vault-canonical"
text = "Canonical project notes in the vault (scoped to the project path)."

# Canonical store served over the filesystem MCP.
#
# Path resolution: keep the vault root out of MCP args. OpenCode only expands
# {env:VAR} at config-load (shell $VAR/${VAR} stay literal); other hosts expand
# ${VAR} from process env at parse time and a sole-arg "${VAR}" can still fail
# when the var is missing then. The wrapper reads CANONICAL_VAULT_PATH from the
# child env at exec time (validates absolute path, allows spaces, expands ~/).
#
# Filesystem package pinned: 2025.7.29+ replaces argv dirs with MCP client
# roots when the client advertises roots (omp/pi), silently re-scoping to cwd.
[[provides.mcp]]
id = "vault-canonical"
command = "bash"
args = ["ai-specs/recipes/vault-canonical-store/bin/vault-fs-mcp.sh"]
env = { CANONICAL_VAULT_PATH = "$CANONICAL_VAULT_PATH" }
timeout = 30000

[[provides.templates]]
source = "templates/vault-fs-mcp.sh"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/vault-canonical-store/bin/vault-fs-mcp.sh"

[[provides.docs]]
source = "README.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/vault-canonical-store/README.md"

[recipe]
id = "session-context"
name = "Session Context"
description = "Foundational session-start discipline: bootstrap focus from the memory/tracker capabilities and resolve source conflicts (tool-agnostic)"
version = "2.0.0"
author = "ai-specs"
license = "MIT"
tags = ["infra"]

# Foundational recipe. Provides the bootstrap + conflict patterns; CONSUMES (by
# convention, see docs/capabilities.md) the `memory`, `tracker`, and
# `canonical-store` capabilities — bind concrete providers in the manifest
# (e.g. trello-mcp-workflow for `tracker`, vault-canonical-store for
# `canonical-store`).
[[capabilities]]
id = "session-bootstrap"

[[capabilities]]
id = "conflict-policy"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "validate-config"

[provides]
skills = [
  { id = "session-bootstrap", source = "bundled" },
  { id = "context-precedence", source = "bundled" },
]

[provides.brief]
workflow_rules = [
    "A session works on one explicit user request or tracker card; resolve focus from memory and tracker before starting.",
]

[[provides.brief.conflict_policy]]
key = "conflict-policy-source-authority"
text = "Current explicit human instruction controls the immediate scope unless it conflicts with safety, secrets, or a higher-authority project rule."

[[provides.brief.conflict_policy]]
key = "conflict-policy-source-hierarchy"
text = "Tracker controls work state; vault controls canonical decisions and handoffs; repo docs and manifests control versioned project contracts. Agent plans are lowest authority until accepted and recorded."

[[provides.docs]]
source = "README.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/session-context/README.md"

[recipe]
id = "tdd-flow"
name = "TDD Flow"
description = "Red-green-refactor discipline with a configurable test command"
version = "1.0.0"
author = "ai-specs"
license = "MIT"
tags = ["quality"]

[[capabilities]]
id = "test-runner"

[[hooks]]
event = "on-sync"
action = "validate-config"

[config.test_command]
required = false
type = "string"
help_text = "Shell command that runs the project's test suite (e.g. ./tests/validate.sh or npm test). Used by tdd-flow RED/GREEN cycles."

[provides]
skills = [{ id = "tdd-flow", source = "bundled" }]
commands = [{ id = "tdd", path = "commands/tdd.md" }]

[provides.brief]
workflow_rules = [
    "Follow red-green-refactor discipline: write a failing test first, then implement, then clean up.",
    "Run the full test suite before committing; do not leave the suite in a failing state.",
]
useful_commands = [
    "Run tests: `{config.test_command}`",
]

[[provides.docs]]
source = "README.md"
target = "ai-specs/recipes/tdd-flow/README.md"
